title: Recover the fixed 2026-08-08 Grade-R card with runner-block and JV RA parsing
hypothesis: A minimal successor adapter can deterministically split the hash-bound 2026-08-08 Target HTML into 36 horse-number-reset runner groups, prove each group against the fixed DU runner identities, bind each race to one pre-race JV-Data RA record, and run the unchanged frozen non-odds M1C candidate stack only for still-on-time flat races.
null_hypothesis: The HTML runner groups, DU runner identities, and RA race metadata cannot be matched one-to-one; any late or unsupported race is accepted; current-day result or market information reaches candidate construction; or any registered race disappears.
racing_mechanism: The repair changes only how fixed pre-race runner blocks and official JV-Data race metadata are decoded. The frozen model, feature schema, action calibrator, confidence threshold, candidate policy, tie-break, market firewall, and original per-race cutoff remain unchanged.
target_population: All 36 races and 462 active runners fixed in DI260808.HTM, DU20260808.DAT, and DR20260808.DAT. At 2026-08-08T12:08:52+09:00, 21 original candidate cutoffs remained, of which 20 were flat; every expired race remains deterministic no-bet and Chukyo 9R remains unsupported.
in_scope: Create a deterministic horse-block parser for the fixed Target HTML using horse-number reset boundaries
Require exactly 462 HTML runner blocks, 36 groups, and an exact one-to-one horse-number and normalized-horse-name set match against DU before inference
Parse exactly 36 pre-race JV-Data RA records for race name, grade, condition, distance, track, course, post time, and runner count using official fixed byte positions
Require RA, DU, target manifest, and schedule identity to agree for every race
Create exactly three 12-race entry snapshots without public entry-page or schedule fetching
During APPROVED_TO_PREPARE, run only synthetic parser, fixed-width field, identity, chronology, forbidden-field, and safety tests
After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, read only the three hash-bound 2026-08-08 local inputs and prior-history sources through 2026-08-07
Use the frozen M1C variance inference bundle, action calibrator, confidence policy, candidate policy, and tie-break without modification
Retain every one of the 36 races as candidate-ready, late/source-not-ready, unsupported-domain, or another explicit fail-closed row
Require candidate freeze persistence acknowledgement before the original registered cutoff
Reject Chukyo 9R and any unknown or obstacle race as NO_BET_UNSUPPORTED_RACE_TYPE
Produce append-only research artifacts with formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
out_of_scope: Any model training, refit, feature addition, calibration change, threshold search, backtest, outer OOS comparison, or ROI calculation
Any candidate reconstruction after its original cutoff or retrospective prospective promotion
Any odds, popularity, market rank, result, payout, ROI, or derivative in candidate generation, ranking, confidence, or abstention
Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote
Any current-day result file, official result, final odds, payout, or post-race feature before outcome joining
Any production dashboard mutation, notification, credential, purchase adapter, TARGET handoff, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any support for obstacle races or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt
Any change to the existing production model, production candidate builder, value policy, BUY policy, or order path

lineage_hash_requirements: The source HTM, DU, DR, three successor target manifests, successor fold manifest, config, frozen inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and every prior-history input are SHA-256 bound before execution
The 462 HTM horse blocks form exactly 36 horse-number-reset groups and each group exactly matches one DU race by horse number and normalized horse name before inference
The 36 DU race keys each match exactly one RA record and RA post time, runner count, distance, track, and domain satisfy the successor input contract
Every candidate-ready row proves feature input source time, generation completion, freeze commit, and persist acknowledgement before its original cutoff
Every prior-history record has race date no later than 2026-08-07 and is available before the target candidate cutoff
Every Top3-set distribution and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks
Every strict-T3 quote references the exact frozen race and unordered pair and has source, received, and selected-asof times at or before cutoff
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, candidate_changed_after_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every registered race remains represented even if late, unsupported, missing, stale, restricted, or otherwise failed closed

chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.input_clock: HTM, DU, and DR hashes and observed modification times are fixed before candidate construction; DR data category must be the pre-race entry category and its post time must match the pre-registered schedule.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only prior-race history through 2026-08-07 that was available before the target cutoff may enter runner features.
chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: A uniquely identified schedule version received before decision is locked before quote access; no actual post time is used retrospectively.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair polling; quote source, receipt, and selected-asof times must all be at or before strict T-3.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.domain_rule: Obstacle and unknown races remain in the denominator but cannot become candidate-ready.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real 2026-08-08 inference, quote, outcome, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No race result dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff or strict-T3 cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 race identities and 462 input runners are fixed independently of market and results.
purge_embargo.price_scope: After candidate freeze, price may only select the pre-registered shadow-ready versus no-bet action for that same pair.

primary_metric.name: all_target_candidate_and_terminal_contract_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: The EXP014 stack has approved synthetic terminal-ledger evidence, but no tracked adapter or approved real-data run exists for the 2026-08-08 multi-card Target input.
primary_metric.evaluation: Fraction of all 36 fixed targets represented exactly once with correct identity, chronology, domain handling, probability invariants, immutable candidate/terminal state, and safety flags.

rejection_gate: The HTM, DU, or DR hash differs from the proposal-bound source
HTML horse-number-reset grouping does not produce exactly 36 groups and 462 runners
Any HTML group, DU runner set, or RA race key fails one-to-one identity
Any RA record is not pre-race data category 2 or its registered post time, runner count, track, distance, or domain conflicts with the fixed card
Any current-day result, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, or derivative reaches candidate construction
Any late candidate is accepted or retrospectively promoted
Any obstacle or unknown race becomes candidate-ready
Any Top3-set or WIDE probability contract violation is accepted
Any quote refers to a different race, ticket type, or pair, or arrives after strict T-3
Any frozen pair changes after odds access or an alternative pair is searched
Any registered race disappears from the candidate or terminal ledger
Any dashboard, notification, credential, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
stop_conditions: The fixed HTM runner-block structure, DU runner universe, or RA race metadata cannot be proved one-to-one
A login challenge, CAPTCHA, access restriction, protected endpoint, credential, or order-capable path is encountered
A current-day result or forbidden market field would be required for candidate construction
A model, feature schema, calibrator, candidate policy, confidence threshold, value threshold, or tie-break change would be required
A late race would need to be backfilled or a cutoff weakened
Any production dashboard, notification, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order path would be invoked
